description: Unique official incident identifier conforming to DGCA CAR Section 5 Series C Part I reporting syntax (DGCA-YYYY-XXXX).
Universal Time Coordinated (UTC) timestamp marking when the aviation occurrence was formally ingested into the safety management system.
Commercial airline flight number active during occurrence (IATA 2-letter airline code followed by 3–4 digits).
Operating Indian scheduled air carrier holding valid DGCA Air Operator Certificate (AOC).
ICAO airframe designation model indicating technical capacity, engine specifications, and operational envelope.
Standard operational flight regime defined under ICAO Annex 6 during which the occurrence took place.
Indicated pressure altitude above Mean Sea Level (MSL) in feet at time of occurrence (0 to 41,000 ft).
Calibrated airspeed (CAS) measured in nautical miles per hour (knots) recorded by FDR/telemetry.
Maximum vertical acceleration (g-load factor) experienced by airframe during flight dynamic upset or touchdown.
Primary taxonomy safety classification mapped against DGCA and ICAO occurrence reporting categories.
ICAO Doc 9859 frequency probability rating: A (Extremely Improbable), B (Improbable), C (Remote), D (Occasional), E (Frequent).
Composite risk classification calculated from 5x5 matrix evaluating whether immediate mitigation (CAPA) is mandated.
Human Factors Analysis and Classification System (HFACS) operational causal hierarchy tier.
Regulatory workflow lifecycle status tracking mandatory safety corrective action completion.
